items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 16 September 2026 9:11am
items.description:
##Yesterday##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W or NW, backing SW, 4 or 5, then increasing 5 or 6 late evening, occasionally increasing 7 early tonight, then veering W overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, soon decreasing slight, then increasing moderate late evening.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers, then occasional rain arriving from the west through the evening and overnight. Clearing later in the night.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
